panels.title: Last 24 hours — sessions / visits by hour
panels.description: Canonical page visits grouped by visit start time. Session counts are distinct within each hour.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(toTimeZone(first_seen,'Asia/Dhaka')) AS hour_bdt, uniqExact(session_id) AS total_sessions, count() AS total_visits, uniqExactIf(session_id,attribution_channel='meta_ads') AS facebook_sessions, countIf(attribution_channel='meta_ads') AS facebook_visits, uniqExactIf(session_id,attribution_channel='tiktok_ads') AS tiktok_sessions, countIf(attribution_channel='tiktok_ads') AS tiktok_visits, uniqExactIf(session_id,attribution_channel='organic_search') AS organic_sessions, countIf(attribution_channel='organic_search') AS organic_visits, uniqExactIf(session_id,attribution_channel NOT IN ('meta_ads','tiktok_ads','organic_search')) AS other_sessions, countIf(attribution_channel NOT IN ('meta_ads','tiktok_ads','organic_search')) AS other_visits FROM telemetry_guard.tg_visits WHERE first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' GROUP BY hour_bdt ORDER BY hour_bdt DESC

panels.title: Last 3 days — sessions / visits by day
panels.description: Daily canonical session and visit totals by source in Bangladesh time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(first_seen,'Asia/Dhaka')) AS day_bdt, uniqExact(session_id) AS total_sessions, count() AS total_visits, uniqExactIf(session_id,attribution_channel='meta_ads') AS facebook_sessions, countIf(attribution_channel='meta_ads') AS facebook_visits, uniqExactIf(session_id,attribution_channel='tiktok_ads') AS tiktok_sessions, countIf(attribution_channel='tiktok_ads') AS tiktok_visits, uniqExactIf(session_id,attribution_channel='organic_search') AS organic_sessions, countIf(attribution_channel='organic_search') AS organic_visits, uniqExactIf(session_id,attribution_channel NOT IN ('meta_ads','tiktok_ads','organic_search')) AS other_sessions, countIf(attribution_channel NOT IN ('meta_ads','tiktok_ads','organic_search')) AS other_visits FROM telemetry_guard.tg_visits WHERE first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' GROUP BY day_bdt ORDER BY day_bdt DESC

SELECT toStartOfHour(first_seen) AS time, multiIf(attribution_channel='meta_ads','Facebook',attribution_channel='tiktok_ads','TikTok',attribution_channel='organic_search','Organic','Other') AS source, count() AS visits FROM telemetry_guard.tg_visits WHERE first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' GROUP BY time,source ORDER BY time

SELECT multiIf(attribution_channel='meta_ads','Facebook',attribution_channel='tiktok_ads','TikTok',attribution_channel='organic_search','Organic','Other') AS source, uniqExactIf(session_id,first_seen>=now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS sessions_24h, countIf(first_seen>=now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS visits_24h, uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions_3d, count() AS visits_3d FROM telemetry_guard.tg_visits WHERE first_seen>=now()-INTERVAL 3 DAY AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' GROUP BY source ORDER BY visits_3d DESC
